tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

{"file_path":"hike.md","content":"# 周末爬山计划

## 一、装备清单

### 必备装备
- [ ] 登山鞋（防滑、已磨合，勿穿新鞋）
- [ ] 登山背包（20–30L，带腰扣）
- [ ] 饮用水（1.5–2L，视天气增减）
- [ ] 路餐干粮（坚果、能量棒、面包、水果）
- [ ] 手机（满电）+ 充电宝
- [ ] 现金少量 + 交通卡/证件

### 衣着穿戴
- [ ] 速干衣裤（忌纯棉贴身）
- [ ] 保暖中层（抓绒/轻薄羽绒）
- [ ] 防风防雨外套（冲锋衣）
- [ ] 遮阳帽 + 太阳镜
- [ ] 备用袜子一双

### 安全与防护
- [ ] 创可贴、消毒棉片、常用药品（防中暑/肠胃药）

## 四、雨天备用方案

### 决策原则
- 出发前一晚查天气：**小雨/阵雨** → 启用雨备方案；**中雨以上、雷暴、大雾预警** → 直接改期。
- 山区天气多变，即使预报晴朗也随身带雨衣（见装备清单）。

### 方案 A：小雨可登山（加强防护）
- 改穿防滑性最好的鞋，登山杖必带。
- 全程雨衣（勿用雨伞，山上易兜风），电子设备用防水袋/密封袋。
